subject: Workplace Skills
title: Surviving a Reorg
description: A short lesson to help you apply Surviving a Reorg.

hook.text: Reorganizations happen every 18 months on average in large companies. Few employees prepare for them.

buildup.text: Reorgs create uncertainty. Roles shift, reporting lines change, and previously safe positions vanish.

discovery.text: Survival depends on relationships and visibility, not just competence. Decision-makers keep people they know.

twist.text: Reorgs are also opportunities. New teams need leaders. Volunteering for transition work creates visibility.

climax.text: During uncertainty, be helpful and visible. Offer to lead the messy coordination nobody else wants.

punchline.text: In a reorg, be the person everyone wants on their team.

quiz.question: What determines who survives a reorganization?
options: Relationships, visibility, and willingness to help during transitions
Being in the right department at the right time
